title: Where Does AI Inference Actually Run?
description: Cloud AI is not the problem. The point is that the network becomes part of the system, so the total response depends on connectivity, transfer time, server availability and the cost of moving data.Edge AI changes the location of inference. The edge can be a microcontroller, a camera, a phone, a vehicle computer, a factory gateway or a local server. The device does not have to be tiny - what matters is that useful intelligence happens near the source of the data.Full episode: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8Pg186B2x1sFull series playlist: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLDSu5OGSP38U#EdgeAI #OnDeviceAI #MachineLearning #AIEngineering
